svg.title: The Vault panel next to the floating Vault reader, drawn from the mods. Not a screenshot.
svg.desc: A drawing, not a screenshot. On the left the Vault panel: the vault picker showing sample-vault with Add vault, the Search notes box, and the file tree of the sample vault with the folders attachments and projects (open, with a and b), then Board, Feature tour (selected), Flow sketch and Other note. On the right the floating Vault reader showing the note Feature tour: its bar with Keep and Close, the properties status, project, tags, aliases and created, the heading, a paragraph with bold, italic, highlighted, struck and inline code text and tags, a line of wikilinks, and the first callouts. Drawn from the mods' own layout code, icons and the Herdr graphite theme, with the sample vault's content; a drawing, not a screenshot.
